name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 62 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.6 days starting 2026-06-01, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.58 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
